newsitem.title: USA: New Era names president, in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: New Era names president, in merger talks.

text.p: New Era Technologies International Inc said Monday it had named a new president and was in negotiations for funding and a possible merger.
Gary Garabedian was named presidebnt. He is restructuring the board and a new one is to be formed at the conclusion of negotiations, New Era said.
It said it was engaged in talks with three different sources for "substantial funding and a possible merger."
"The discussions are proceeding in a positive manner and should be concluded in four to six weeks," the company said in a statement.
New Era officials copuld not be reached for further comment.
In early January Stephen Fleming resigned as New Era chairman, chief executive and acting president.
